claim_register.claim: The process applies only to strategic-flow cashflows with technical failures. BCS flow, data issues, and business exceptions remain excluded. PSS recovery must remain temporary and exceptional. PSS may act only within explicitly agreed, documented scope. Development owns root-cause analysis, recovery design, permanent fixes, and automation. Ops validates outcomes when business confirmation is required.

claim_register.claim: For a P4-or-higher incident under the Impact Assessment Matrix, or two occurrences within one week, complete root-cause analysis. Present a remediation plan and estimated delivery date by week end. Target the next available deployment window. More than three manual recoveries within one month require prioritization for the next major release cycle. Other repeated recovery becomes resilience or control debt, prioritized by impact and effort. Development owns analysis and design; PSS supports validation. Prefer this work before new low-priority enhancements.
